description: This file defines API routes/endpoints for a financial tracker backend application using FastAPI. It includes route definitions for authentication, user profiles, categories, transactions, budgets, dashboard summaries, and reports. The code sets up various routers, defines endpoints with their respective CRUD operations, and references models, database sessions, and authentication utilities.

methods.name: register(user: UserCreate)
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating a new user after verifying uniqueness of email and username.

methods.name: login(form_data: UserLogin)
methods.description: Authenticates a user and issues a JWT token upon successful login.

methods.name: get_profile(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user's profile information.

methods.name: list_categories(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all categories.

methods.name: create_category(cat: CategoryIn, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new expense or income category.

methods.name: update_category(category_id: int, cat: CategoryIn, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates an existing category by ID.

methods.name: list_transactions( skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), start_date: Optional[date] = Query(None), end_date: Optional[date] = Query(None), category_id: Optional[int] = Query(None) )
methods.description: Fetches transactions for the authenticated user with optional filtering.

methods.name: update_transaction(transaction_id: int, tx: TransactionIn, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction by ID.

methods.name: set_budget(budget: BudgetIn, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Sets or updates a budget for a category and period.

methods.name: get_budgets(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves all budgets for the current user.

methods.name: get_dashboard(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Provides an overview of the user's financial data: income, expense, balance, and top transactions.

methods.name: generate_report(request: ReportRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Generates financial reports grouped by category or month based on filters.
